title: Placed and released
caption: Near-goal episode 53, 51 steps, final object-to-goal error 4.7 mm against a 5 mm tolerance. The green cube is set square on the blue base and the fingers lift clear: hand 174 mm from the cube at the end, cube moving at 10 mm/s. The success predicate requires none of that -- it tests one distance and would score a cube still held at the goal point identically -- so the release is measured separately and every one of the six genuine successes in this rollout satisfies it.
